deactivate.title: Deactivate {{name}}?
deactivate.description: {{first}} can’t sign in any more. Their chats, pages and files stay, named after them. You can reactivate them later; what ends below stays ended.
deactivate.impactFailed: Could not load what it would end.
deactivate.transferRefused: The transfer failed, so {{first}} was not deactivated and nothing moved: {{why}}
deactivate.transferLost: Couldn’t confirm the transfer finished ({{why}}), so {{first}} was not deactivated. What they own is loaded again below: check it before you try again.
deactivate.keysMade_one: {{first}} made it and saw its secret.
deactivate.keysMade_other: {{first}} made them and saw their secrets.
deactivate.newKey: Make {{account}} a new key before you go on:

ends.roomsHandedOver_one: {{count}} room where {{first}} is the last admin
ends.roomsHandedOver_other: {{count}} rooms where {{first}} is the last admin
ends.roomsArchived_one: {{count}} room with nobody left to run it
ends.roomsArchived_other: {{count}} rooms with nobody left to run it

deactivate.step3: If the transfer fails, nothing moves and {{first}} is not deactivated.

reactivate.title: Reactivate {{name}}?
reactivate.description: {{first}} can sign in again, with the role they had. What their deactivation ended doesn’t come back: service keys they made, connected agents and socio access stay revoked, and their sessions stay signed out. Their scheduled tasks stay paused until they resume them.

transfer.loadFailed: Could not load what they own.
transfer.lost: Couldn’t confirm the transfer finished ({{why}}). What {{first}} owns now is loaded again: check it before you try again.
transfer.title: Transfer what {{name}} owns
transfer.description: The company owns its people’s work: hand it to another active person. Secrets {{first}} holds personally (subscription logins, OAuth tokens) never move.
transfer.description_done: What {{first}} owned of these kinds is {{to}}’s now. Both people’s activity records it.
transfer.nobodyActive: Nobody else is active to receive it.
transfer.partial: What stays with {{first}} can still be linked to what moves: a schedule can move while the socio it runs as stays theirs, or an app while a Space it posts to doesn’t. Transfer everything unless you mean to split it.

makeOwner.title: Make {{name}} the workspace owner?
makeOwner.description: The owner is the one admin other admins can’t demote, deactivate or remove. You stay an admin; {{first}} can hand ownership on the same way. Every admin is told.
makeOwner.withPasskey: Make {{first}} the owner with a passkey
makeOwner.failed: Could not make them the owner.

remove.title: Remove {{name}} permanently?
remove.description: This deletes them and what is only theirs for good, after a backup. It can’t be undone in the app. Deactivating is the reversible choice.
remove.description_done: Their records are gone. A backup was made first.
remove.records_one: {{count}} record the planner lists for this
remove.records_other: {{count}} records the planner lists for this

help.owned: Removal deletes what they own. The company keeps it: hand it to someone first.
help.deactivate: Only a deactivated person can be removed, so their sessions and keys have ended first.
help.self: Another admin has to remove your account.
help.lastAdmin: Someone must keep managing the workspace: make another person an admin first.
help.owner: The workspace owner stays an active admin. The owner can make another admin the owner first.
help.listed: They own it, and removal never takes what they own with them: transfer it first.
help.unpurged: Records that removal doesn’t delete still point at them: transfer what they own, or end these in the app first.
help.protected: Part of what would go is protected (built in), so nothing is removed.

remove.keptNote: These records stay and still name them by an id that no longer resolves to a person.
remove.cleanupFailed: Removing their files didn’t finish: {{error}} Run <code/> on the server to finish it.
remove.stepUp: Then confirm it’s you. Every admin can see the removal in the audit log.
